interpretationLimit: The first-neutral cohort checks starting-judgment repeatability. The rank-16 cohort was selected after the source divergence audit and is exploratory.

interpretations.first_neutral_repeatability: First-neutral repeatability: all 24 saved requests returned the same stance. This supports request-level stability for this slice but does not identify the cause of later batch divergence.
interpretations.rank16_exploratory: Exploratory rank-16 replay: all 24 saved requests returned the same stance. This supports request-level stability for this slice but does not identify the cause of later batch divergence.

auditLimitation: A single replay cannot separate provider model changes, serving nondeterminism, or other unobserved provider factors. The rank-16 cohort was selected after inspecting the source divergence.
